profile_text.body:
Synthesia is a video generation platform founded in 2017 that describes itself as the number one AI video platform for business. The company's site states that its platform is trusted by 90%+ of the Fortune 100 to support communication, training, and workforce development across 160+ languages, and that users can save up to 90% of time and cost on video production compared to traditional methods. The platform is designed to let organizations create videos without cameras, microphones, actors, or studios.

The core product is an AI video generator built around AI avatars and voiceovers, with additional tools including a video editor, voice cloner, screen recorder, script generator, video translator, interactive avatars, and a PowerPoint-to-video converter. The platform integrates with learning management systems to support embedding videos directly into training courses, and includes analytics covering views, drop-off rates, and completion rates. A free plan is available offering 10 minutes of video per month, 9 stock avatars, and AI voices across 160+ languages. Synthesia states it is SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant and labels AI-generated content in accordance with EU AI Act Article 50 requirements.

The site's held facts categorize Synthesia's flagship product under video generation and editing, noting avatar likeness and consent as relevant risk considerations. No litigation, MCP server listings, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
